title: Munhu Wekutanga Kukumbira Ruregerero
intro: Dzokera shure panguva iyo zuva risati rabuda, munhu asati ambofamba panyika. Chifananidzo chakagadzirwa nezvinhu zvakaderera, chakapihwa nzvimbo pamusoro pengirozi, ndokuiswa mubindu dzvene nenyevero yakajeka. Asi munguva pfupi, sarudzo yakaitwa - imwe yaizodzokorora nhoroondo yese yevanhu. Ndiani chifananidzo ichi?
clues: Ndakasikwa nenzira yakasiyana nedzimwe — ndakaumbwa kubva muguruva renyika ndikapihwa mweya mupenyu neruoko rweMusiki.
Ndakapiwa ruzivo rwakadzama zvekuti kunyange ngirozi dziri kumusoro dzakashamiswa narwo.
Denga rese rakarairwa kuti rikotame pamberi pangu, uye vese vakazviisa pasi - kunze kwemumwe chete, akaramba nekuda kwekuzvikudza.
Ndakaiswa mubindu dzvene, nzvimbo yenyaradzo nekugara ndichidya - asi ndichirambidzwa chimwe chete.
Ndakakanganwa, ndakatsvedza, uye handina kuteerera — uye ndakanzwa kuremerwa kwechikanganiso changu zvakadzama.
Ndakatendeukira kuna Ishe wangu nemashoko emwoyo wese, uye Akabvuma kupfidza kwangu, nekuti Iye ndiye Anoregerera Zvikuru.

arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍۢ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful. (2:37)
